persos.desc: young father in his 30s, rust-and-salmon polo shirt, big grateful smile, one hand on the cradle
persos.pose: standing beside the cradle on the left

dialogue: Pourquoi ton bébé s'appelle Konan comme moi ?!
Pour honorer l'homme qui a payé l'accouchement, mon vieux.
Et mon argent, alors ?
Le prochain aussi va s'appeler Konan dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. Konan, in the foreground, points at the cradle, outraged. The father puts his free hand on his heart and answers proudly. Konan opens his hands and asks. The father pats the cradle and announces it with a warm grateful smile, his face clearly visible.
chute: Konan freezes, his hands still open, his eyes wide. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the creditor Konan's panicked face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: KONAN EN BLOQUANT LE NUMÉRO DU PAPA :
mecanisme: escalade : l'hommage devient un abonnement, le débiteur annonce déjà le prochain prêt
